query: select (select count(*) from public.league_members) as members, (select count(*) from public.teams) as teams, (select count(*) from public.auction_records where status = 'sold') as sold, (select count(*) from public.auction_records where status = 'unsold') as unsold, (select count(*) from public.auction_records where status = 'not_called') as not_called limit 1;
